parties: Sonia Agarwal Bajaj; Donear Industries Limited
headline: Sonia Agarwal Bajaj submits SEBI Takeover Regulation 10(5) disclosure to NSE for Donear Industries
sum: Sonia Agarwal Bajaj filed a substantial acquisition of shares (SAS) / takeover disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, Regulation 10(5), with NSE in relation to Donear Industries Limited. The disclosure marks initiation of regulatory process for a material shareholding or control transaction in the listed apparel company.
implication: Regulation 10(5) disclosure signals commencement of a substantial acquisition or change of control; partners must monitor for formal open offer notice and timeline for public announcement under SEBI Takeover Code, typically within two trading days of crossing disclosure thresholds.
detail: Sonia Agarwal Bajaj, an individual acquirer, submitted a mandatory disclosure to NSE under Regulation 10(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011. This disclosure is triggered when an acquirer crosses prescribed shareholding thresholds (typically 25% of voting capital or when acquisition results in change of control). The filing indicates an imminent open offer or control transaction. Donear Industries, a listed apparel and fashion company, is the target. The specific consideration value, shareholding percentage, and offer structure have not been disclosed in this preliminary regulatory notice.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 – Regulation 10(5)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement when acquirer acquires shares resulting in substantial acquisition or change of control; triggers open offer obligation.
Definition of 'acquirer' and 'substantial acquisition' (acquisition of 25% or more of voting capital, or control); prescribes thresholds and timelines.
Open Offer – timing (within 2 trading days of crossing threshold), offer price (30-day or 6-month volume-weighted average), and public announcement.
Acquisition of shares and takeover governance; board approval and shareholder approval thresholds for change of control.
Disclosure of material events by the target company (Donear) to stock exchange; timing and content requirements for public announcement.
Filing, verification, and dissemination of takeover disclosures and open offer notices; exchange surveillance and enforcement.
If acquirer is non-resident or has foreign investment component, FDI route approval and RBI reporting required.

framework.note: Antifraud and insider trading safeguards; timing of disclosures and parity of information to all shareholders.
